snippet.title: Pokémon Legends: Z-A – Mega Dimension – Nintendo Direct 9.12.2025
snippet.description:
New Mega-Evolved Pokémon have been discovered in Lumiose City! 
 
What is the cause of this recent emergence of new Mega Evolutions? Find out when Pokémon Legends: Z-A – Mega Dimension DLC comes to Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 soon.

#PokemonLegendsZA #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoSwitch #NintendoDirect
